//: The ts-mcp pack (ADR 2026-063): MCP tools as an in adapter, and the MCP app template. adapterTechnologies declares the `mcp` in technology: the @exposedVia token, the folder contexts/<context>/src/adapters/in/mcp/, the package export ./adapters/mcp and the feature role `tool`. generatedFileGlobs write-protects that folder, every file of which is emitted from the feature contracts (TN-26-012 §6). workspaceTemplates.mcp is the app a TN declares as `apps/<name>: mcp`: a stdio server hosting one context's MCP server.
//productSurfaces: What this pack lets the product be used from (ADR 2026-065). bounded init maps the product spec to these surfaces and selects the pack that serves each needed one.

adapterTechnologies.description: MCP tools, one per feature tagged @exposedVia mcp, registered on one server per context; the in port's JSDoc summary is the tool description

mcp.description: An MCP server app: src/main.ts connects the composed server to a stdio transport; src/composition-root.ts wires the context's handlers and adapters.

//tnExampleWorkspaces: The app this pack's template makes, as bounded init shows it in the example workspaces map of docs/tn/README.md.
